overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures spray dried strawberry powder from carefully selected ripe strawberries. Processed using controlled drying technology, this fine powder retains the authentic sensory profile, natural aroma, and rich colour of fresh fruit. As an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter based in India, we deliver reliable raw materials designed for seamless commercial food processing.

Our production adheres to a structured six-step process, from sourcing and cleaning to controlled drying, grinding, and quality inspection. The resulting powder features fine mesh consistency, excellent solubility, and less than five percent moisture content. We supply bulk ingredient shipments alongside custom packaging and private label solutions to satisfy precise commercial formulation requirements.
highlights: Fine mesh specification of 80 to 100 mesh
Moisture content maintained below five percent
High solubility in various food applications
Authentic strawberry aroma and natural fruit colour
Extended shelf life of 18 to 24 months
applications: Dairy items including yogurts and ice creams
packaging: 25 kg bags or HDPE containers for bulk volume
Small private label pouches and jars

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for this product?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 kg, accommodating pilot production trials as well as standard commercial orders.

faqs.q: Can you provide product samples prior to bulk orders?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide product samples on request to allow industrial buyers to evaluate quality and suitability.

faqs.q: What processing technology is used to manufacture the powder?
faqs.a: We utilize advanced spray-drying technology with precision temperature control to transform strawberry puree into fine, soluble powder.

faqs.q: Do you support private label and custom packaging needs?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide OEM services, private label packing into retail pouches or jars, and custom packaging formats.

faqs.q: What export credentials and documentation support do you offer?
faqs.a: We are an IEC-registered exporter and FSSAI-registered supplier, offering complete export documentation support for international shipments.

faqs.q: What are the recommended storage conditions for this powder?
faqs.a: Store the powder in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture to maintain freshness.
